Provider bills are settled by provider credentials, which the operator configures.Pick a modelModel IDs take the form author/model, for example anthropic/claude-sonnet-5. Try a model in Chat before you write code: the conversation runs through the same route your SDK will take.PresetsA preset is a saved routing recipe: model, parameters, and fallbacks under one name.
